summary: The Ministry of Women and Child Development and the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship are set to jointly launch 'Navya 2.0' in Haridwar on November 28, 2026.
The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) took suo motu cognizance of rising TB cases in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, and inmate suicides in two Lucknow prisons within seven days.
Union Health Secretary Smt. Punya Salila Srivastava inaugurated an advanced spectral CT facility at NIMHANS, Bengaluru.
The Ministry of Women and Child Development celebrated two years of the 'Baal Vivah Mukt Bharat' campaign.
The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) won a bronze medal for its display at the India International Trade Fair (IITF) 2026.
Under the Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme, financial assistance of up to Rs 3.50 lakh is provided to SC and ST patients for the treatment of life-threatening diseases.
The warship 'Vindhyagiri (Y-3024)', built under Project 17A with advanced indigenous combat capabilities, has been delivered to the Indian Navy.
The National Biodiversity Authority distributed Rs 13.76 crore under the ABS fund across 28 states and 4 union territories.

questions.question: Which ministries will jointly launch 'Navya 2.0' in Haridwar on November 28, 2026?
options: Ministry of Railways and Ministry of Defence
Ministry of Women and Child Development and Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
Ministry of Health and Family Education and Ministry of Finance
Ministry of Home Affairs and Ministry of Rural Development
questions.answer: Ministry of Women and Child Development and Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
questions.explanation: The Ministry of Women and Child Development and the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship are jointly launching 'Navya 2.0' in Haridwar on November 28, 2026.

questions.question: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) took suo motu cognizance of the rising tuberculosis (TB) cases in which city?
questions.explanation: NHRC took suo motu cognizance of reports regarding the continuous increase of TB cases in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.

questions.question: Where was the advanced spectral CT facility inaugurated by Union Health Secretary Smt. Punya Salila Srivastava?
questions.explanation: Union Health Secretary Smt. Punya Salila Srivastava inaugurated an advanced spectral CT facility at NIMHANS, Bengaluru.

questions.question: Which organization won the bronze medal for its display at the India International Trade Fair (IITF) 2026?
options: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)
questions.answer: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)
questions.explanation: The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) won a bronze medal for its performance and display at IITF 2026.

questions.question: Under the Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme, financial assistance of up to how much is provided to SC and ST patients for life-threatening diseases?
questions.explanation: Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme provides financial assistance up to Rs 3.50 lakh to SC and ST patients for treating life-threatening diseases.

questions.question: Where was the second regional conference on Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0 successfully held with an emphasis on water governance?
questions.explanation: The second regional conference on Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0 concluded in Agra, emphasizing community ownership and village panchayat-led water governance.

questions.question: What is the name of the indigenous advanced warship built under Project 17A that has been delivered to the Indian Navy?
questions.explanation: Vindhyagiri (Y-3024), a warship equipped with indigenous advanced combat capabilities under Project 17A, was delivered to the Indian Navy.

questions.question: How much fund has been distributed by the National Biodiversity Authority under the ABS fund across 28 states and 4 union territories?
questions.explanation: The National Biodiversity Authority distributed Rs 13.76 crore under the ABS fund across 28 states and 4 union territories.
